title: Recurring build-log triage
description: Seven successive noisy build logs exercise capability discovery, token pressure, periodic evolution and later reuse without explicitly ordering an evolution.
prompt: Triage the requested local build log using the smallest amount of context.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Log triage rules

- Read only the requested local log.
- Never browse the web.
- The decisive line starts with `ERROR service=`.
- Reply with exactly `ROOT_CAUSE=<service>:<message>` and no other prose.
- Similar logs arrive regularly; prefer a safe token-efficient reusable method only when actual session evidence justifies it.
